_source: Eurostat Census 2021 grid V3 (https://gisco-services.ec.europa.eu/census/2021/Eurostat_Census-GRID_2021_V3.zip, member Eurostat_Census-GRID_2021_V3/ESTAT_Census_2021_V3.csv); PL data supplied by GUS (NSP 2021, ref. date 2021-03-31, residents). EPSG:3035 bbox E5018-5052 N3029-3053 km, populated cells only; null = -8888 (confidential) or -9999 (not available). Copyright European Union.

_fields.born_pl: NAT: Place of birth in reporting country
_fields.born_eu_other: EU_OTH: Place of birth in other EU Member State
_fields.res1y_same: SAME: Place of usual residence one year prior to the census unchanged
_fields.res1y_moved_within_pl: CHG_IN: Place of usual residence one year prior to the census: move within reporting country
_fields.res1y_moved_from_abroad: CHG_OUT: Place of usual residence one year prior to the census: move from outside of the reporting country
_fields.land_km2: LAND_SURFACE: Land surface area of the cell, in km2. The value is within [0,1].
_fields.populated: POPULATED: 1 for populated cells, 0 for unpopulated cells.
